correctness.rationale: For n>=6, Proposition 8.3 gives all n(n-1) maximal pure strong matchings from a path after deleting a last vertex. Reflections s_a(v)=a-v exchange incidence signs on edge e_i with partner e_(a-i-1). Their geometric fixed points are precisely equal-barycentric-weight unions of eligible two-element incidence orbits, giving a canonical PL orbit-face realization. The necessary two-consecutive-omitted-edge condition selects the exact P/N interval families; all subsets of either family fit one rooted-path facet and a mixed choice either double-uses an edge or forces four alternations of signs, forbidden by the single-block structure. For odd n=2m+1 both components have m-1 orbit vertices, for even n=2m vertex axes m-1 and edge axes m-2, so the dimensions and all n boundary cases are correct. Ordinary fixed Euler=2 implies reduced Lefschetz=1 after equivariant barycentric subdivision. Independently reconstructed all rooted-path facets from graph endpoints and root positions, formed incidence orbits and maximal orbit-face sets for 38 conjugacy-representative (n,axis) cases at n=6..30, including n=6, and all were exactly two simplices of predicted sizes. Independently serialized the eight retrieved actual Git blob identifiers into a Git tree and obtained assigned tree SHA 24f209329c0ba261c1932a6717f2604629654773. Finite enumeration corroborates, and is not relied on for the unrestricted n theorem.

final_claim: For every n>=6 and every reflection s_a(v)=a-v of the unfilled cycle, the geometric fixed-point space of the pure strong Morse matching complex SM_pure(C_n) is PL-homeomorphic to two disjoint closed d-dimensional simplices, where d=(n-5)/2 for odd n, d=n/2-2 for even n and vertex-axis a even, and d=n/2-3 for even n and edge-axis a odd. Thus reduced integral homology is Z in degree 0 and zero otherwise and the reduced rational homological Lefschetz number is +1. The result is entirely covered by exact published earlier October 25 and November 1 formulas and proofs; no surviving new final claim is supplied.
